patch.value: GH-1571: allow projection of active extension item fields across read surfaces

Reported on published 2026.10.24: full reads retain typed registerItemFields values but get/list/search --fields reject them as unknown_field_projection. Preserve extension-defined context through compact SDK and CLI reads using the active runtime field registry. Intake only; independently reproducing and implementing the fix are future work.

Add a sandbox reproduction against the active runtime registry covering SDK and CLI get/list/search.; Preserve numeric and other supported declared field values and reject truly unknown names without silently dropping requested fields.; Keep CLI and MCP adapters on shared SDK projection contracts and update discovery and recovery where needed.; Prove extension activation isolation and built-in projection compatibility through meaningful regression tests and linked evidence.
Reporter: published npm CLI and SDK 2026.10.24 in a plain temporary directory without git; local schema-capability extension registers optional numeric probe_score.

Use the attached source reproduction in the item body: init a temporary tracker; activate a local registerItemFields extension; create probe_score=3; compare full get with projected SDK get and CLI get/list/search.
Active extension fields are projectable in SDK and CLI get/list/search with their original names and types. Unknown fields still produce truthful recovery that preserves caller intent.

Reporter observed probe_score=3 in a full SDK get but selecting id,probe_score is rejected by SDK get and CLI get/list/search. Recovery drops the requested field; not independently reproduced during intake.
